snippet.title: Exoborne | Upcoming Playtest | Into the Infinite 2025
snippet.description:
The storm is only the beginning.
Get a closer look at Exoborne, the upcoming  tactical open-world extraction shooter where danger comes from every direction.

Scavenge, survive, and suit-up as you begin the journey in Colton County.

Sign up for the upcoming playtest: https://lvli.li/Exoborne

Developed by Sharkmob
